create_make_dmlab_environment: create a DMLab environment with configurable args, observations, and seed for deterministic simulation
test_test_player_position: test that performing the same action N times produces identical player positions across two environments
test_test_frame_skip: test that skipping render frames simulates the same player positions as not frame skipping
test_test_repeated_actions: test that calling step(a, N) produces the same result as calling step(a, 1) N times
test_test_pbo_pixels: test that pixel outputs are identical whether using PBOs or not
